parameters.jsCode:
const data = $input.all()[0].json;
const esc = (s) => String(s || '').replace(/'/g, "''");

const q = "INSERT INTO candidatures (mandat_id, nom, prenom, email, telephone, nationalite, genre, annees_experience, niveau_formation, domaine_formation, dernier_poste, secteurs_exp, certifications, langues, competences_cles, points_forts, points_faibles, score, score_justification, recommendation, cv_url, statut, created_at) VALUES (" +
  data.mandat_id + ", '" +
  data.nom + "', '" +
  data.prenom + "', '" +
  esc(data.email_candidat) + "', '" +
  esc(data.telephone) + "', '" +
  data.nationalite + "', '" +
  data.genre + "', " +
  data.annees_experience + ", '" +
  data.niveau_formation + "', '" +
  data.domaine_formation + "', '" +
  data.dernier_poste + "', '" +
  data.secteurs_exp + "'::jsonb, '" +
  data.certifications + "'::jsonb, '" +
  data.langues + "'::jsonb, '" +
  data.competences_cles + "'::jsonb, '" +
  data.points_forts + "'::jsonb, '" +
  data.points_faibles + "'::jsonb, " +
  data.score + ", '" +
  data.score_justification + "', '" +
  data.recommendation + "', '" +
  esc(data.cv_url) + "', 'recu', NOW()) RETURNING id";

return [{ json: { insert_query: q } }];
